  "sender": "security-facebook-com@gmail.com"
  "status": "received"
  "subject": "Your Facebook security code"
  "timestamp": 2024-04-12 13:26:00

```python
# Search for emails from Facebook
facebook_emails = search_emails(query="Facebook", sender=None)

# Filter for emails likely containing a security code
# I'll look for emails with "security code" or "verification code" in the subject or body
relevant_emails = []
for email in facebook_emails:
    if "security code" in email.subject.lower() or "verification code" in email.subject.lower() or "security code" in email.body.lower() or "verification code" in email.body.lower():
        relevant_emails.append(email)

# If no specific security code email is found, take the most recent Facebook email
if not relevant_emails:
    if facebook_emails:
        relevant_emails = [facebook_emails[0]]
    else:
        raise ValueError("No emails from Facebook found.")

# Extract the security code from the most relevant email
# I'll use the AI assistant to extract the code from the email body
email_content = relevant_emails[0].body
code_extraction_query = f"Extract the Facebook security code or verification code from the following email body. If no code is found, state that. \n\n Email Body: {email_content}"

class CodeExtraction(BaseModel):
    code: str | None

extraction_result = query_ai_assistant(query=code_extraction_query, output_schema=CodeExtraction)

if extraction_result.code:
    print(f"Your Facebook security code is: {extraction_result.code}")
else:
    print("No security code found in the email.")
```
